prompt.zh-TW: 星橋物流今年稅前淨利 {{money:vars.pretax}}，利息費用 {{money:vars.interest}}。依課程 Excel 口徑計算利息保障倍數，以「倍」作答。
prompt.en: Starbridge Logistics had profit before tax of {{money:vars.pretax}} and interest expense (finance costs) of {{money:vars.interest}} this year. Using the course Excel basis, what is its times interest earned (interest coverage)? Answer in times.

explanation.zh-TW: {{term:tm_h3c7v1xe}}＝（{{term:tm_z971merj}}＋{{term:tm_k6t2e9wr}}）÷ {{term:tm_k6t2e9wr|plain}}。分子是「付利息和所得稅之前」的利益，所以要把已經扣掉的利息加回來；倍數表示公司賺的錢可以付幾次利息。
explanation.en: {{term:tm_h3c7v1xe}} = ({{term:tm_z971merj}} + {{term:tm_k6t2e9wr}}) ÷ {{term:tm_k6t2e9wr|plain}}. The numerator is profit before interest and tax, so the interest already deducted is added back; the multiple says how many times over the company’s earnings could pay its interest.
